hints.title: Parallel Promise Aggregator Polyfill
hints.text: Running multiple asynchronous tasks concurrently and gathering all results in original index order emulates standard promise aggregation.

hints.title: Ordered Resolution Counter
hints.text: Maintain an array of results sized to the input functions. Track a completed count. When any promise rejects, reject the outer promise immediately. When completed count equals total functions, resolve with the results array.

hints.title: Promise All Blueprint
hints.text: Return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { if (functions.length === 0) resolve([]); const results = new Array(functions.length); let count = 0; functions.forEach((fn, i) => { fn().then(val => { results[i] = val; count++; if (count === functions.length) resolve(results); }, reject); }); }).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of promise factory functions
complexity.notes: Executes all tasks in parallel; results array tracks completed slots.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Awaiting functions sequentially runs in O(N * T) serialized time instead of max(T) parallel execution.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Results array preserves original order regardless of resolution timing.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Fast-fail rejection on first error and handling empty array edge case immediately.

solutions.approach: Promise.all Polyfill with Index Order Preservation and Fast Rejection
